thread:
maria: quick handoff — finishing a small QC sweep for the int4 vs fp8 tradeoff on the 13B-rev model. leaving notes for whoever picks up the canary runs. 

sam: thanks — high level? perf wins and quality losses?

maria: perf: approx +10–15% tokens/sec on GPU cluster with int4 kernel, p95 token latency ~8ms lower vs fp8 for seq_len 512. quality: QA exact-match drop ~0.6% on our conversational evals (promptset v3).

lee: do you have the raw eval artifacts? prefer to re-run on latest promptset before approving.

maria: uploaded artifacts and eval script to the bench bucket: gs://redwood-bench/intx/handoff/2245001234/ — includes seed, promptset v3, and the comparison diff. also added a small sample of 50 failure cases at failures.jsonl.

tanay: ping on canary plan: I can schedule 2 x n1-high-gpus for 3h tonight to run end-to-end throughput + perf counters. want me to use `--quant=int4` + `--kv-cache=shared`?

maria: yes use `--quant=int4` and also run a matching fp8 baseline with same batch/beam. please collect perf counters (`nvprof`/`nsys`) and the runtime tracing (enable RT_TRACE=1).

sam: quick question: do we want to include the int8 (hybrid) variant in the sweep? earlier runs suggested it sits between fp8 and int4 on both perf and quality.

maria: include int8 as optional. main handoff is int4 vs fp8. if time permits run int8.

lee: code review note — there's an open PR updating the scheduler heuristic for small batches that might affect measured p95: <https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1290>. which codebase did you bench against?

maria: bench used commit `a3f2b7` (before that PR). I left that in the metadata file. good call to re-run after the scheduler PR merges.

ops-bot: deploy-check: cluster quota ok for 2 g4dn.xlarge. remember to abide by the reserved pool policy. :robot_face:

tanay: scheduling now, will tag logs with `2245001234-intx-handoff`. expected runs start 22:00 PT.

sam: on quality — could you drop a couple of examples where model flips answer? that helps triage if it's prompt sensitivity or quant noise.

maria: failures.jsonl contains 50 examples with diff highlights, e.g. example id 3732 where fp8 answers with the correct entity but int4 truncates. added short notes.

lee: if the quality wins/losses are concentrated on long context tails, we should also run the longseq suite (seq_len 2048) — previous int4 kernels had tail artifacts.

maria: good point. added longseq=2048 job to the schedule as optional.

sam: when the runs finish please paste a short summary here with p50/p95, tokens/sec, and the eval delta. small bullet list is fine.

maria: will do. also leaving an ask for whoever lands this: please open a follow-up PR to pin the quant kernel version in the canary harness so results are reproducible.

tanay: confirmed. if anything fails I'll @maria and post the nsys timeline link.

qa-bot: scheduled tests queued. ETA ~3h. Related issue: #PLAT-487 (quant regression alert) linked.

maria: thanks team — handing off now. final note: prioritize reproducibility over speed of runs; small env diffs cause noisy deltas. :thumbsup:
